meta.title: Mobile app shows correct L1 highlight in QCS ranking
gaps: Open the Procol mobile app as the buyer
Verify that Vendor A's row is visually highlighted as L1
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Open the Procol mobile app as the buyer; Verify that Vendor A's row is visually highlighted as L1
